title: A Second Halloween 🎃
excerpt: October 23 marks the anniversary of our first Halloween update announcement! Today, we celebrate our second Halloween together with a special theme, Friend Filters, unfriend history on Roblox, and major improvements to removal reliability, performance, and stability. 👻🕸️
body: Friends Remover celebrates our second Halloween with a special seasonal theme and a major collection of new features, improvements, and fixes. This update introduces Friend Filters, unfriend history directly on Roblox's official Friends List, single-friend removal, removal ranks in the Friends List, and more control over background removals. We've also improved rate-limit detection, removal reliability, popup performance, and interface stability. The Compact Viewer and friend reporting system have also been removed as we continue refining the extension.

added.moreInfo: Introduced a gray default theme for users who prefer a neutral appearance.
Introduced a special Halloween theme, which is now the default theme through November 5, 2026.
Replaced the previous status filter with a dedicated Friend Filters system featuring multiple options for filtering friends in both the popup and Roblox's official Friends List page.
You can now remove individual friends directly from Roblox's official Friends List page.
Moved unfriend history from the popup directly to Roblox's official Friends page, making it easier to access your friend removal history.

You can now choose whether removals are allowed to continue in the background after starting a removal session in the popup. If background removals are disabled, closing the popup interrupts the session and pauses the removal process. When you reopen the popup, you'll be asked whether to continue or cancel the removal.

added.text: Untrust Friends from the Friends List
added.moreInfo: You can now untrust people directly from the Friends List, making it easier to manage your trusted friends.
Added translation support for the extension's context menu.
Removal ranks are now displayed in the Friends List.
Added a warning to the removal screen when Roblox is rate-limiting requests.

removed.moreInfo: Removed the Compact Viewer as part of the extension's ongoing changes and improvements.

Officially discontinued and removed the friend reporting system. The feature saw very little use, and maintaining a separate reporting system was no longer a priority. Friends Remover will continue focusing on helping users manage and remove friends efficiently.
Removed friend status displays due to the additional API requests they generated and their limited usefulness.
Removed Block Mode in favor of Free Mode.
Removed the duplicate Refresh action from the friends-load error screen. Try Again is now the only recovery button and still clears the cache before retrying the status check.
Removed numerous resource-intensive animations to reduce unnecessary popup processing and improve performance.

removed.text: Mutual Friends Viewer from the Removal Screen
removed.moreInfo: Removed the Mutual Friends Viewer from the removal screen when Mutual Mode is enabled.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue that prevented the settings menu from working correctly on mobile devices.

fixed.text: Search, Filter, and Quick Action Controls
fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue where multiple controls could remain open simultaneously. Opening Search, Filter, Quick Actions, or the three-dots menu now automatically closes the previously open control without disabling the newly selected one.
Fixed an extra line appearing in welcome messages in the menu.
Fixed the Mutual Viewer layout so it correctly starts at the top of the profile frame and extends to the bottom.
Fixed refreshing the Friends List Viewer so it stays open instead of returning users to the main menu.

Fixed missing failure notifications when removing fewer than five friends. Small batches use a toast instead of the full removal screen, and the toast now correctly reports failures and rate limiting.

Implemented worker-enforced removal locking, disabled removal controls during active runs, persistent status tracking for small batches, and shared rate limiting across manual and automated removals to prevent conflicting removal processes.

improved.moreInfo: Updated the icons used for removal ranks.
Optimized image assets to reduce excessive memory usage caused by unnecessarily large images.
Replaced the old extension logo with the new logo.
Improved theme selection loading speed so selecting a theme is now quicker, similar to switching color themes.
The pin button is no longer displayed for trusted friends, preventing unnecessary pinning actions for people who are already trusted.
Increased the menu headshot size from 110px to 120px.
Reduced the gap between the welcome message and the menu buttons from 24px to 12px.
Added more detailed logging to the uninstall page to make troubleshooting easier.
The Refresh button in the Friends List now displays a loading screen while refreshing.
Improved rate-limit detection so the extension can identify rate limiting earlier and determine when to pause and resume removal requests.
Improved coordination between manual and automated removals, including shared rate-limit handling, active-run locking, and more reliable removal status tracking.
